contenders.label: ai-sdk-cpp (ClickHouse)
per_request: request JSON built with nlohmann::json
a new TCP and TLS connection for every request (cpp-httplib builds a new client per call)
a retry wrapper (default 2 retries, 2 s initial delay) that only acts on retryable failures
a thread per stream, and an event iterator that sleeps 1 ms when its queue is empty
logger calls compiled in, logger off by default
does not link libcurl (cpp-httplib over OpenSSL), so it has one row and the two libcurl builds do not apply to it

na.openai/buffered: the SDK's buffered path builds its client from the bare string 'host:port' (cpp-httplib's SSLClient(host) then connects to port 443), so it cannot reach a TLS server on any other port; the peer cannot bind port 443 without privileges, and an unprivileged network namespace is not available on the hosts
na.anthropic/buffered: the SDK's buffered path builds its client from the bare string 'host:port' (cpp-httplib's SSLClient(host) then connects to port 443), so it cannot reach a TLS server on any other port; the peer cannot bind port 443 without privileges, and an unprivileged network namespace is not available on the hosts

contenders.label: genai (Rust)
per_request: request built through genai's adapter dispatch (serde_json values)
typed response parsing into genai's chat types
gzip accepted on the wire (genai's default)
tracing events compiled in; no subscriber is installed
no retries
contenders.pool_note: genai's streamers end a stream at its terminal event ([DONE], message_stop) and stop polling the response body, so the connection can only go back to reqwest's pool if the end of the body had already arrived; the new connections in the window are the observed consequence

contenders.label: openai (Python)

na.anthropic: the SDK speaks the OpenAI API only

per_request: pydantic construction and validation of the typed response and of every stream chunk
x-stainless-* platform headers on every request
default retry settings (max_retries=2), not triggered

contenders.label: anthropic (Python)

na.openai: the SDK speaks the Messages API only

per_request: pydantic construction of the typed response; the streaming helper also accumulates the message
x-stainless-* platform headers on every request
default retry settings (max_retries=2), not triggered

contenders.label: LiteLLM SDK
contenders.env_note: LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True uses the model cost map shipped in the wheel; without it litellm downloads the map from the network at import, which the benchmark must not depend on (and which fails against the peer-only trust store, with retries).
per_request: model-string parsing and provider resolution
parameter mapping (get_optional_params) and a logging object per call
success handlers after each call, including completion_cost and, for streams, stream_chunk_builder and token counting
response conversion into litellm's ModelResponse
default retry settings, not triggered
litellm.telemetry=False; the model cost map is read from the wheel, not the network

contenders.label: any-llm
per_request: wraps the official openai and anthropic SDKs, so every per-request cost of those SDKs applies
converts each response and each stream chunk into any-llm's own pydantic types
parameter mapping through its CompletionParams
contenders.pool_note: streamed Anthropic requests occasionally open a connection after the warm-up (seen at c=32 in two smoke runs); the cause was not established

contenders.label: aisuite
contenders.pool_note: aisuite cannot size the underlying SDK's pool, whose default keeps 100 idle connections
per_request: wraps the official openai and anthropic SDKs (older majors than the standalone baselines, as aisuite's constraints require)
message conversion before the call and response post-processing (thinking-content extraction) after it
for Anthropic, every stream event is converted into an OpenAI-shaped chunk
trace sinks exist but none is registered

concurrency_cap_note.anthropic/buffered: aisuite's Anthropic provider has no async buffered call, so acreate offloads the SDK's synchronous call with asyncio.to_thread; the default executor has min(32, CPU count + 4) threads, which caps the requests actually in flight

contenders.label: Vercel AI SDK
per_request: prompt standardisation and call-setting validation
zod-schema validation of every provider response and stream chunk
default retries (maxRetries=2, exponential backoff), not triggered
for streamText, a transform-stream pipeline and step bookkeeping
telemetry off unless experimental_telemetry is set
